en.html:
...Why?

Why had I been struck down?

I did not understand.

I had grasped Silver Star's breathing.

Her <ruby>intent<rt>intent</rt></ruby>... I thought I had understood it.

But not one sign had reached me. Silver Star's attack arrived without warning and blew me away.

Why?

Had I misunderstood everything?

Sensing an enemy's breathing across such an endless distance—only delusion, after all?

Or...

If not that.

Had grasping Silver Star's intent <ruby>served no purpose<rt>・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>?

That enemy. That younger sister. That Demon King.

Had she already arrived there?

The furthest state a warrior could reach: <ruby>taking up<rt>taking up</rt></ruby> the sword without intent.

—<ruby>The Sword of No Thought<rt>Musouken</rt></ruby>.

en.html:
...Consciousness kept rising and sinking.

Dream... and <ruby>waking reality<rt>waking</rt></ruby>.

Which was which...

No clear border remained.

They muddied. They slipped away.

Defeat and death were coming. I knew that.

But... what of it?

I had <ruby>staked<rt>staked</rt></ruby> everything on this battle. That had been my intention.

All my strength.

All my vows.

All my resolve.

Even then, not enough.

Not nearly. Not at all.

Then...

What was left to do?
